title: A transition carries the sound across the cut too
goal: Put a dissolve between two clips and the picture blends, but the sound still jumps from one clip to the next at the edit point, so the exported video has a hard audio cut, often a click, right in the middle of a smooth picture change. A Final Cut editor expects the dissolve to cross-fade the sound as well, and a Premiere editor applies both with one key. Make a transition on a cut blend the two clips' own sound over the same stretch, in playback and in the exported file.
notes: From the audit rough line in queue/audits/2026-09-23-transition-picker-at-a-cut.json: 'Transitions between clips only change the picture: the sound still cuts hard at the edit point.' Checked by reading, 2026-09-24: ClipTransitions.swift (PhotonzCore) is picture only, and AudioMix.swift / DocumentAudioPlayer.swift / DocumentMovieWriter.swift never mention a transition. Not reproduced by ear (the probe cannot listen), so this is a gap to build, not a p1 bug. Linked sound segments come from a-clip-s-sound-is-on-the-timeline-from-the-momen; volume ramps already exist in AudioMix. No new control: the existing transition drives it.
acceptance: At Next defaults, open the sample talk, cut it, drop the b-roll after it, click the join and pick Dissolve: playing across the join, the sound of the first clip fades out while the second fades in over the transition's length, instead of switching at the edit point
The exported MP4 has the same blend (a test reads the mixed samples either side of the edit point and finds no step)
A cut with no transition still cuts the sound where it cuts the picture, and a dip to black dips the sound with it
Sound on its own track that is not linked to either clip (music) is not touched
Tests on the mix plan are written before the code
anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not
